items.raw_excerpt: Tamil Nadu increases self-certification limit for residential building approvals to 5,000 sq. ft., enhancing urban development initiatives.
items.summary_en: The Tamil Nadu state assembly has increased the self-certification limit for residential building approvals to 5,000 square feet. The change is part of a broader push to speed up urban housing development. Homeowners can now approve small projects without waiting for lengthy government inspections.

items.raw_excerpt: A Dutch man has fathered at least 121 children as a sperm donor and is still active, according to an investigation by current affairs programme Nieuwsuur – the latest in a line of mass donors who exploit a gap in the legal rules by working outside licensed clinics. The man, who is 43 and from the Groningen region, donated to several sperm banks but operates mainly online, approaching women directly. Investigators spoke to dozens of affected mothers, and said the...
items.summary_en: A 43-year-old man from the Groningen region of the Netherlands has fathered at least 121 children. He works mainly online, approaching women directly and bypassing licensed sperm banks. An investigation by the TV programme Nieuwsuur found he is exploiting a gap in Dutch law.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 그로닝겐 지역의 43세 남성이 정자 기증으로 아이를 최소 121명 낳은 것으로 확인됐다. 이 남성은 인가된 정자 은행을 거치지 않고 주로 온라인을 통해 여성들에게 직접 접근해 온 것으로 조사됐다. 네덜란드 시사 프로그램 뉴스셔의 조사 결과, 해당 남성은 네덜란드 법의 허점을 이용해 활동을 계속하고 있는 것으로 드러났다.
items.title_en: Dutch man fathered 121 kids as sperm donor
